Notification No. E9/111/Legal Asst. Appointment/2026
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for appointment to the post
of Legal Assistant (Full Time) on Consolidated pay, subject to the following
qualifications and conditions:
Instructions for Candidates:
1. The completed application, along with two sets of self-attested copies of
the required supporting documents, shall be submitted to “The Registrar.
Bharathiar University, Coimbatore – 641046”.
2. After scrutiny by the committee, eligible candidates will be called for an
interview and the same will be communicated to them separately.
3. The above post is purely temporary.
4. The Identification-Cum-Personal Information Sheet can be downloaded from
the University website www.b-u.ac.in.
DATES TO BE REMEMBERED:
(a) Date of commencement of downloading the application form: 01.09.2026.
(b) Last date for receipt of duly filled in application form: 16.09.2026, 5.30 p.m.
